$comment: Curated catalogue of user-facing capabilities — the denominator for documentation coverage. One row per capability. `manual` = covered in USER_GUIDE.md; `book` = covered in a docs/guide chapter; `bookExample` = that chapter carries a worked example. `since` is the date the capability shipped (YYYY-MM-DD). Guarded by scripts/check-feature-coverage.mjs and consumed by scripts/build-stats.mjs.
